title: Bijectivity of the fixed additive section comparison
statement: Let f:X→S be flat proper locally of finite presentation and L invertible. For arbitrary k:W→S and t:T→W, the explicitly constructed additive map [def-sc-picard-direct-image-section-map] from derived test sections to Γ(X_T,L_T) is bijective. This asserts only the pointwise bijectivity of a fixed map, with no successive-base-change claim.

source.document: Stacks Project, Derived Categories of Schemes and Cohomology of Sheaves
source.place: Tags 0B91 clause (2), 08HY, 0D5S; parent proof step 1: base change, derived adjunction and evaluation give the additive equivalences

proof.text: Set q=pr_W, p=pr_T and M=pr_X^*L as in the section-map definition. Identify tensor pullback with ordinary pullback by the unique left-adjoint comparison. Ordinary pullback preserves scheme-module invertibility; IsInvertible.sheafOfModules_isInvertible and transport by this comparison give sheaf-level invertibility of M. The iterated-pullback square is cartesian by IsPullback.of_right and the two chosen pullback squares. Properness supplies quasi-compactness and separatedness after base change, and flatness is stable under base change.

Apply isIso_derivedBaseChange_of_flat_invertible to q, t, the iterated-pullback map and p. Compose with Rp_* of canonicalSinglePullbackMap at M and the fixed coefficient isomorphism d. All factors are invertible. canonicalSinglePullbackMap at the structure sheaf and pullbackObjUnitToUnit also give the source isomorphism e. Iso.homCongr e (asIso B) is exactly xi -> e.inv >> xi >> B, so it is bijective.

Rp_*(N[0]) is nonnegative by the proved source-library Functor.isGE_rightDerivedFunctor_obj_singleFunctor. The structure sheaf in degree zero is nonpositive. Apply the proved source-library DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor_map_bijective_of_isLE_of_isGE at zero. Conjugate the resulting homology morphisms by the single-homology source isomorphism z and canonicalDirectImageH0Iso p N. Iso.homCongr and composition of bijections give the displayed module-morphism comparison.

Apply the proved Modules.unitHomAddEquiv to the pushforward of N, then restrict from inverse-image top to top. This restriction is invertible: the open morphism has inverse homOfLE p.preimage_top.le, with the two inverse identities following from subsingleton homs. Its presheaf image therefore gives a bijection. Compose these bijections. Functor.map_comp and associativity identify their composite definitionally with the fixed section map. No point or nonemptiness is used.

lean.statement:
theorem picardDirectImageSectionMap_bijective
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{v},
      HasDerivedCategory.{v + 1} (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X S : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [Flat f] [IsProper f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible]
    (W : Scheme.{v}) (k : W ⟶ S) {T : Scheme.{v}} (t : T ⟶ W) :
    Function.Bijective (picardDirectImageSectionMap f L W k t)
